name: Trödelmarkt HansaMarkt
facts: flea market and weekly market in one
fresh fruit and vegetables every Sunday
freshly smoked fish: trout, hake, eel, mackerel
field kitchen: currywurst, bratwurst, home cooking, soups, soft-serve ice cream, coffee
covered stalls with storage boxes for traders, by the day or by the month
pitches charged by the metre, with own table, rented table or car
notes: Organiser date list runs only to 27.12.2026 (headed "Termine 2026"), so January 2027 Sundays are left out until they publish 2027. Impressum page on the site is empty (Jimdo placeholder); organiser name taken from the contact block. E-mail from the site footer. Entry fee not stated.

description.de: Trödelmarkt und Wochenmarkt in einem, mitten in Weißensee. Zwischen den Ständen mit Gebrauchtem gibt es frisches Obst und Gemüse und frisch geräucherten Fisch – Forelle, Aal, Makrele. An der Feldküche warten Currywurst, Hausmannskost und Softeis, falls das Stöbern länger dauert.
description.en: A flea market and a weekly market in one, in Weißensee. Between the second-hand stalls you’ll find fresh fruit and veg and freshly smoked fish – trout, eel, mackerel. The field kitchen does currywurst, home cooking and soft-serve, in case the rummaging runs long.
